meta.description: Registry for participation_space measure and cardinality structures in Phase 2 of the Mono-Process Formal Law Program.

participation_measure_classes.meaning: participation_space is finite and measured by cardinality.
participation_space is countable and may require summability conditions.
participation_space carries a measure for density or integration.
participation loci carry weights from residue, orientation, or admissibility.
No measure/cardinality structure has been declared.

measure_entries.normalization_rule: participation_density = non_null_locus_count / total_locus_count when total_locus_count is finite and nonzero
participation_density is represented as measure(non_null_region) / measure(total_region) when a valid measure exists
density remains undefined until cardinality or measure structure is declared
